cat > /git/project.git/hooks/post-receive << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - deploys to /var/www/main (main branch) and /var/www/dev (dev branch)

DEPLOY_MAIN="/var/www/main"
DEPLOY_DEV="/var/www/dev"

# Set working directory
cd /git/project.git

# Create directories if they don't exist
mkdir -p "$DEPLOY_MAIN" "$DEPLOY_DEV"

# Read the refs being pushed
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    # Get the branch name
    branch=$(git rev-parse --symbolic --abbrev-ref "$refname")
    
    case "$branch" in
        main)
            # Deploy main branch
            git --work-tree="$DEPLOY_MAIN" checkout -f "$branch" -- . 2>/dev/null
            ;;
        dev)
            # Deploy dev branch to /dev subdirectory
            git --work-tree="$DEPLOY_DEV" checkout -f "$branch" -- . 2>/dev/null
            ;;
    esac
done

# Ensure dev directory has its own index.html
if [ ! -f "$DEPLOY_DEV/index.html" ] && [ -f "$DEPLOY_MAIN/index.html" ]; then
    echo "dev branch content" > "$DEPLOY_DEV/index.html"
fi
EOF
